أقتبس (form VIII)
# أَقْتَبِسُ (ʔaqtabisu) /ʔaq.ta.bi.su/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
# أُقْتَبَسُ (ʔuqtabasu) /ʔuq.ta.ba.su/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
# أَقْتَبِسَ (ʔaqtabisa) /ʔaq.ta.bi.sa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
# أُقْتَبَسَ (ʔuqtabasa) /ʔuq.ta.ba
